reply_text:
Before recording these, I'm checking each recommendation against the plan's requirements and your earlier rulings. Two may conflict: whether (b) must reach selection, and ε.Decisions recorded. Decision 6B-2 fixes the bins, which unblocks the last scan carrier, so I'm sending that now.I've recorded the six item 6 (b) decisions in the plan as 6B-1 to 6B-6. Five are my recommendations as they stood, or with a small amendment. The ε one conflicted with your earlier ruling, so I recorded it in the form that keeps that ruling.

**6B-6, ε:** I had recommended classing `[R4 R3a]` as not required by design. On 2026-09-28 you ruled that it "stays open, not by-design", so I didn't adopt that. The decision now says ε is not part of item 6 (b), and `[R4 R3a]` stays open until ε has a consumer. The intended consumer is the token-channel precision.

**6B-3, amended:** the learning starts from new ticks only, not a fit on the old data first, because old ticks have no raw counts. The learned model computes its own status responsibilities rather than reusing the hand-set model's beliefs, which is what removes the circularity.

**6B-5, checked against your rule:** item 6 (b) counts as done when the learned model drives the declared entity's status belief; reaching target choice isn't required. Item 6's written requirement asks for scoring and recording. Your rule that a fundamental is done only when live selection uses it covers C, G, find and organise, and item 6 isn't claimed as one of those. So the decision doesn't loosen that rule.

Each decision says what it's consistent with, and what reopening it would involve. They sit in the plan's decisions section (futon2 `24ef2acb7`, published).

The bin decision (6B-2) unblocked the last scan carrier, so I've sent it:

| Packet | Seat | Job | Park |
|---|---|---|---|
| SCAN-CARRIER-BINS-I | codex-proof2a | `invoke-1790644758303-27031-56ebfa49` | `park-810b1b31` |
| SCAN-CARRIER-ANNOTATION-I | codex-proof2b | `invoke-1790644558694-27021-72914ebe` | `park-d7e950fb` |

After these two, all fourteen channels save exact counts or a versioned bin on each tick. The next packet is the learner. Nothing needs you in the meantime.
